implementation: PracticeDSPGenerationCoordinator gains actor-serialized count-in consume/discard authority without changing prior public entry points

consumeScheduledCountIn requires exact click generation and click count, clears raw pendingCountInClicks, and deliberately preserves the executor generation so an already accepted count-in is not flushed
discardCurrentCountIn and exact discardCountIn clear raw pending state, advance schedule generation, revoke combined replacement authority, and invalidate the click queue
discard failure after mutation start poisons the coordinator and attempts equal-or-newer-generation queue invalidation fail closed
generation overflow can still use equal-generation queue invalidation as a stale-queue flush
Lane3SerializedPracticeClickGate supersedes AW20 as selected count-in product route and performs coordinator discard before interruption transport boundary
selected route count-in planning requires exact arm generation, closing AW20 newer-generation authorization tolerance
schedule commit revokes AW20 one-shot authorization before serialized raw-state consume; consume failure attempts exact-authority discard
interruption boundary flag is set before first await so re-entrant product count-in arm cannot appear between discard and transport transition

portable_benchmark.scope: actor-based semantic microbenchmark for arm plus consume/discard ordering and queue-invalidation bookkeeping; excludes repository production backend cost, AVAudioEngine, AVAudioSession, Apple click-node execution, file/device IO, real audio and current-Moises execution
